text.description_html:
Acorn RPDBP, Heart Door Pull

Acorn's RPDBP Heart Tip Black Iron pull handle is easily surface mounted to almost any door. Very nice large size (11" high) door pull makes opening bigger doors easier. It is often used on gates, barn doors and garage doors. Its rough iron finish mimics that of naturally weathered iron. Plus, its packaged with matching black bron finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also Available 11" Inch Black Iron Heart Door Pull with 3-3/8" projection.

Specifications of the Acorn RPDBP Heart Door Pull:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Pull Height: 11"
  • Weight: 2-5/8"
  • Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Material: Cast Iron
  • Lifetime No-Rust Finish Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
